title: Government Proposes MDR on Select UPI Payments

blocks.content: The Union Ministry of Finance proposed amendments to the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, on 3 August 2026 to reintroduce Merchant Discount Rate on select digital payment modes. The proposal seeks to remove the zero MDR provision under Section 10A, which currently bars banks and payment system providers from levying charges on online transactions, including Unified Payments Interface and RuPay debit card payments.

items: Section 10A of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 currently provides for zero MDR on specified digital transactions.
Unified Payments Interface was launched by the National Payments Corporation of India for instant bank-to-bank transfers.
RuPay is India’s domestic card network developed by the National Payments Corporation of India.
Merchant Discount Rate is usually expressed as a percentage of the transaction value.
